pages.text: They had run out of butter. It was sold at the yellow market tent.
"Just look for the yellow tent." Mom put a basket in Coco's hand.
Coco met Grandpa Mole at the market entrance. "Butter? This way." They reached a cheese shop.
Mrs. Magpie flew over. "Butter is that way!" They reached a honey shop.
Mr. Pig waved. "The biggest tent is best!" The biggest tent sold potatoes.
Coco's head was spinning. Each of the three insisted their way was right.
Coco stood on tiptoe and looked around the market. A yellow tent stood at the far end.
Coco walked straight to the yellow tent. All three hurried after Coco.
"Butter, please!" Coco received butter wrapped in yellow paper.
On the way back, all three said together, "Without us, you would have been in trouble." Coco just smiled.
